# 2 Baruch Chapter 49 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And I answered and said: "In what form will those live who live in your day? Or how will the glory of those who come after that time continue?"

**2** "Will they then take up again this form of the present, and put on these chains that are in evil, by which all evil things are done?"

**3** "Or will you perhaps change these things which have been in the world, as also the world itself?"

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
